records.name: Deep Agents SDK
records.one_liner: Middleware, tools and backends assembled onto LangChain/LangGraph, with checkpoint durability configured through the underlying runtime.
used_by: AI SDK Deep Agents harness adapter

features_notes.plugins: Programmatic middleware/profile entry points; product plugin loader is in dcode.
features_notes.durable_resume: Configured LangGraph checkpointer plus external host re-invocation; default checkpointer=None.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Partner remote/container backends, not SDK-enforced host isolation.
features_notes.otel: LangSmith/inherited callbacks; OTel availability depends on integration.
features_notes.agents_md: Memory/instruction middleware; product discovery differs from SDK configuration.

dims.loop: create_deep_agent returns LangChain create_agent graph; Deep Agents does not own a separate runtime.
dims.providers: LangChain chat-model integrations and model-specific harness profiles.
dims.tools: Filesystem/planning/task tools, offloading and execution-capable backend contracts.
dims.context: Summarization middleware, skills, memory files and tool-output offloading.
dims.state: LangGraph checkpointing when configured; default None has no cross-invocation persistence and no worker scheduler.
dims.safety: Path permissions/HITL; command execution is not governed by those file rules, isolation is backend-owned.
dims.extensibility: Composable middleware, profiles, backend protocols and skills; dcode plugin system is separate.
dims.multi_agent: Task subgraphs, parallel delegates, forked and remote async subagents.
dims.surfaces: First-class SDK graph; dcode TUI/ACP and Open SWE server are separate products.
dims.observability: LangSmith callbacks and framework state/debug streams; dedicated eval code also exists.
